I ordered this set of remote holders for my bedroom after moving into a new apartment where there are several remotes for the lights in addition to the television. I have one of these holders on the wall above the nightstand on each side of my bed. As long as you can get into the habit of ensuring the remotes are in one of the holders whenever you get up and make your bed, these will certainly come in handy!  The included dividers make it so that smaller remotes don’t simply fall onto their side and disappear inside the holder. These are also a great spot to charge your phone overnight, as there is an opening in the bottom to allow a charging cord to connect through. The adhesive strips they came with are strong and have b stayed put since the day I installed them almost two months ago. There were also screws included for those who prevent to mount it this way. The price is about average/slightly less than average compared to other remote holders this size/quantity on Amazon ($18 for a 2-pack in Black & White at the time of writing this review). Overall, I’m super happy with these because I’ve been able to keep better track of my remotes this way and would highly recommend!

This plastic remote holder comes with two divider slots that can be removed to just make one opening to hold your remotes.It comes with two screws to mount it into the wall and has two screw holes in the back part of the remote holder for easy access to mount it.I chose to use the sticky back tape to mount it to our wall but by the next morning it had fallen to the ground. We only had two remotes in it at the time, so I‘m not sure if the tape just isn‘t strong enough, or the paint on the wall wasn‘t allowing it to get a good bond.So I‘m just going to use the two screws and mount it that way.

This 3 Slot Adjustable Remote Control Holder is a basic, clean design. The three slots are separated by dividers that can be removed to create one open space or two spaces with one twice as large as the other.The plastic is thick and smooth, and the holder can be mounted using the included screws and anchors or the included 3M foam double-sided adhesive panel. The grip on both sides of the panel is extremely strong and difficult to remove once applied, so ensure that you get your positioning exactly right before peeling off the backing and applying it.While the intent for this is to attach it to a wall, the adhesive is strong enough that I was able to attach it to the legs of an end table by cutting away strips of the backing to reveal the sticky material on only the slim lines I needed. Even with four remotes inserted into the holder, it isn‘t budging.This is extremely useful and versatile. It‘s definitely a good option to keep remote controls organized and easily accessible.

Great set for $19. These caddies are well made and sturdy. Screws and anchors were included but I didn‘t use them.  They weren‘t the heavy duty quality but decent enough for the price and weight of these caddies. But I didn‘t use them because screwed in caddies, even with anchors, then to fall off the wall. I have teens, big kids and little kids. They aren‘t delicate and can be rough, careless or just clumsy. So the wall caddies that are screwed in eventually fall off due to constant touching or tugging. You can see the yellow wall anchor from a previous caddy in my pic of the black caddy. RIP to my original wall caddy, lol. So I love that these caddies brought full back adhesive. The adhesive sticker covers the entire back of the caddy and that baby is holding on strong, lol! Its been 2 weeks and hasn‘t budged. The slots are optional. Each caddy has 2 slot inserts. They are removable but not adjustable. So you can‘t adjust the width of the slots but you can remove 1 insert to create a larger slot.
